title: jams engine project file, format v1

$schema.description: The project JSON Schema this file follows.

id.description: The project's id: the first half of its scene and asset doc names, unique on the site.

module.description: The module, relative to this file ("./index.ts").

export.description: The name the module exports the GameDefinition under.

game.description: The module that exports the game's definition; null for an engine-only project.

ui.description: The module that exports the game's DOM UI (a MountUi), mounted over the canvas by hosts; the CLI never imports it.

module.description: The module, relative to this file ("./ui/index.ts").

export.description: The name the module exports the MountUi function under.

items.description: A POSIX glob relative to the project root; a leading "!" excludes.

assets.description: Globs of files that may be assets.

items.description: A POSIX glob relative to the project root; a leading "!" excludes.

code.description: Globs of code modules the project tree lists read-only.

items.description: A POSIX glob relative to the project root; a leading "!" excludes.

ignore.description: Extra excludes beside the fixed ones: *.schema.json, *.asset.json, jams.project.json, __tests__, node_modules and dist.

description: A project's root file (jams.project.json): its id, its game and UI modules and which files are assets and code. Kept in git, never co-edited.
